key.name: minimize
key.summary: How a window goes into the dock and comes back
key.description: droplet: it gathers into a drop of glass and arcs into its icon. shrink: GNOME's own, it shrinks and fades into its icon. With Reduce motion on, a window fades in place either way.

key.name: workspace-switch
key.description: depth: the wallpaper slides a third as far as the windows, which step back a little on the way. slide: GNOME's own.

key.name: speed
key.description: snappy (0.4 of each animation's time), normal (0.6), relaxed (0.9) or off (nothing moves; GNOME's own Animations switch is left as it is). The power saver and the light desktop halve it. Reduce motion still turns movement into fades.

key.name: open-close
key.description: pop: a window grows into place from a little smaller. slide: it rises a little as it appears. fade: it only fades in. gnome: GNOME's own. Closing plays it backwards; dialogs keep GNOME's; with Reduce motion on, it fades.
